transcribed_question:
a) Transverse Pericardial Sinus
b) fossa ovalis
c) septum primum

marker.description: Blue probe or instrument inserted into the superior aspect of the heart

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the blue probe.
main_explanation: The probe is inserted into the space behind the great vessels (aorta and pulmonary trunk) and in front of the superior vena cava, which is the transverse pericardial sinus.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located posterior to the transverse pericardial sinus?
supporting_question.explanation: The transverse pericardial sinus is a space between the great vessels (aorta and pulmonary trunk) anteriorly and the superior vena cava posteriorly.
